theme: contaminated land remediation groundwater and environmental permitting

sources.title: Land affected by contamination
sources.facts: Explains source-pathway-receptor assessment, desk studies, site investigation and links between planning, Part 2A and permitting.
sources.guard: Planning guidance does not prove a site is uncontaminated, investigated or suitable for use.

sources.title: Land contamination: technical guidance
sources.facts: Collection updated 13 May 2026 covering risk management, Part 2A, permitting, groundwater, health and ecological receptors.
sources.guard: A guidance collection does not prove any site-specific assessment or remediation outcome.

sources.title: LCRM: Before you start
sources.facts: Sets a risk-based framework for assessment, options appraisal, remediation and verification.
sources.guard: Following a framework is not evidence that risks are acceptable or remediation has worked.

sources.title: Check if you need an environmental permit
sources.facts: Updated 2 March 2026; identifies activities that may need permits because of pollution, flood, drainage or water-resource effects.
sources.guard: A permit checker does not prove exemption, permit grant or lawful operation.

sources.title: Apply for an environmental permit
sources.facts: Published February 2026; explains checks, advice, costs, online applications and post-grant steps.
sources.guard: Application guidance does not prove an application is valid, determined or granted.

sources.title: Environmental permitting: H5 Site condition report
sources.facts: Describes recording land and groundwater condition during the permitted-site lifecycle and permit surrender.
sources.guard: A template does not establish baseline condition, protection performance or satisfactory surrender.

sources.title: Get voluntary remediation advice for contaminated land and groundwater
sources.facts: Published 3 June 2026; advisory service for controlled-water contamination outside specified regulatory processes.
sources.guard: Availability or receipt of advice does not equal regulatory approval or completed remediation.

sources.title: Contaminated land statutory guidance
sources.facts: Explains determination and remediation principles under Part 2A of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
sources.guard: Statutory guidance does not prove land has or has not been formally determined as contaminated land.

package_guard: Contamination guidance, risk frameworks, permit information, templates and statutory rules do not by themselves prove exact-site contamination status, pollutant linkages, groundwater impact, remediation success, permit requirement, exemption, permit grant, planning acceptability, safe occupation or development viability.
